headline: Cecar EMAS Exchange, Only One Buyer, Operating Cash Negative
summary: Merdeka Gold Resources (EMAS) explained its financial performance and customer diversification strategy to the Indonesia Stock Exchange. The disclosure covers operating cash flow that was negative in the period.
why: Merdeka Gold Resources is an Indonesian gold miner listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange. Its earnings and sales diversification shape investor views of its gold output.
original_headline: Bursa Cecar EMAS, Pembeli Cuma Satu, Kas Operasi Minus
